name: Our Tongue
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and responsibility inherent in our use of the tongue. The psalmist commits to guarding his speech to avoid sin, recognizing the need for self-control (Psalms 39:1). Proverbs highlights the tongue's dual capacity to harm or heal, comparing harmful words to sword piercings and describing a wholesome tongue as a source of life and healing (Proverbs 12:18; 15:4). Moreover, the tongue holds the power over life and death, with those who cherish it reaping its consequences (Proverbs 18:21), while falsehood and deceit spoken by the tongue bring just punishment (Proverbs 19:5). These truths underscore the necessity of submitting our speech to God's wisdom and grace.
